metadata: Linnaeus was professor at University of Uppsala eminent botanist however , one of his colleagues , Peter Artedi , earned title father of ichthyology through his indispensable advancements . John Ray , English naturalist , was first to attempt biological definition of species in 1686 , as follows In 18th century , Swedish scientist Carl Linnaeus classified organisms according to shared physical characteristics , not simply based upon differences . He established idea of taxonomic hierarchy of classification based upon observable characteristics intended to reflect natural relationships . Biological classification is form of scientific taxonomy . Modern biological classification has its root in work of Carl Linnaeus , who grouped species according to shared physical characteristics . These groupings have since been revised to improve consistency with Darwinian principle of common descent . Molecular phylogenetics , which uses DNA sequences as data , has driven many recent revisions is likely to continue to do so . Biological classification belongs to science of zoological systematics .
